description.en: V20 is an automatic window cleaning robot with dual water spray nozzles and a microfiber pad. Strong suction holds it to glass while edge detection and anti-fall protection keep it safe on frameless panes; the remote control starts, pauses and directs cleaning paths. A built-in rechargeable battery provides backup power for windows, mirrors, shower glass and glass doors.
description.zh: V20 自动擦窗机器人，配双喷水喷嘴与超细纤维清洁布。强吸力牢固吸附玻璃，边缘侦测与防跌落保护让无框玻璃也安全；遥控器可启动、暂停并指定清洁路径。内置可充电电池作为断电备用电源，适用于窗户、镜子、淋浴房玻璃与玻璃门。
description.ar: V20 — روبوت تنظيف نوافذ أوتوماتيكي من AquaClean يجمع فوهتا رش ماء مزدوجتان مع كشف الحواف وحماية من السقوط وتشغيل بجهاز تحكم عن بعد. يلتصق بالزجاج بقوة شفط عالية وينظف النوافذ والمرايا وأبواب الزجاج، مع بطارية احتياطية ودعم OEM/ODM.
description.es: V20 es un robot limpiacristales automático de AquaClean que combina doble boquilla de pulverización, detección de bordes y protección anticaída y control por mando a distancia. Se adhiere al cristal por succión y limpia ventanas, espejos y puertas de vidrio, con batería de respaldo y soporte OEM/ODM.
description.fr: V20 est un robot lave-vitres automatique AquaClean associant double buse de pulvérisation, détection des bords et protection anti-chute et commande à distance. Il adhère au verre par aspiration et nettoie fenêtres, miroirs et portes vitrées, avec batterie de secours et OEM/ODM possible.
description.id: V20 adalah robot pembersih kaca otomatis AquaClean yang memadukan nozzle semprotan air ganda, deteksi tepi dan perlindungan anti-jatuh, dan kontrol jarak jauh. Menempel pada kaca dengan hisapan kuat dan membersihkan jendela, cermin, serta pintu kaca; ada baterai cadangan, mendukung OEM/ODM.
description.ru: V20 — автоматический робот для мойки окон AquaClean с двойные форсунки распыления, определение краёв и защита от падения и управление с пульта. Удерживается на стекле мощным всасыванием и моет окна, зеркала и стеклянные двери; резервный аккумулятор, поддержка OEM/ODM.
description.th: V20 หุ่นยนต์ทำความสะอาดกระจกอัตโนมัติ AquaClean ผสานหัวฉีดน้ำคู่ ตรวจจับขอบและป้องกันการตก และควบคุมด้วยรีโมท ยึดติดกระจกด้วยแรงดูดสูง ทำความสะอาดหน้าต่าง กระจก และประตูกระจก มีแบตเตอรี่สำรอง รองรับ OEM/ODM
description.vi: V20 là robot lau kính tự động AquaClean kết hợp hai vòi phun nước, phát hiện cạnh và chống rơi và điều khiển từ xa. Bám kính bằng lực hút mạnh, lau cửa sổ, gương và cửa kính; có pin dự phòng, hỗ trợ OEM/ODM.

reviews.name: Wei Zhang
reviews.title: Finally safe window cleaning on our 30th floor apartment
reviews.body: Living on the 30th floor, window cleaning has always been dangerous. This robot handles both exterior and interior glass with its AI-powered path planning. The safety rope holds 150kg. Our windows have never been this clean.

reviews.name: Olivia Brown
reviews.title: Perfect for floor-to-ceiling glass offices
reviews.body: We manage a small office building and this robot has replaced our quarterly window cleaning service. It works on any glass thickness from 3mm to 35mm and the edge detection prevents it from falling off. The 3.5m extension cord covers most spaces.

reviews.name: Marco Rossi
reviews.title: Works well on large glass panels — minor learning curve
reviews.body: It takes about 5 minutes to learn the remote control and the app. Once you know how to set the cleaning path, it does an excellent job. Best results are on smooth, frameless glass. Ours are framed windows so it leaves a small 2cm gap at the edges.
